answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vertex. What survives to the willow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
